venues.name: An Craoibhín
venues.note: Pub: family-run gastro pub on The Crescent; open from 09:00. Irish breakfasts in the morning, a lunch menu of traditional dishes like roast beef, bacon and cabbage and curry, and a main menu of steaks, salmon and pasta, with starters. Book ahead. Skipper's review: “Usually arrive at rush hour and still get shown straight to a snug table. Service is attentive, friendly, professional and quick. The food is traditional pub grub done very well: the curry is basic, rice and chips, and exactly right for it; the roast beef is a big plate. The room is warm and mixed – workmen, tourists, locals and professionals all squeezed in together, squinting at the blackboard menu. One visit, a visitor asked hopefully about lamb, expecting nothing, and was offered the lamb stew. He was delighted. When I left he was halfway through it and in heaven.”
